turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of a class, nobody called me, and I want to know who decided that and when.
Thanks for coming in. The zero went in before I called you, and that was wrong.
Okay. Now tell me what the zero is based on.
I will remove the zero tomorrow morning. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch on Thursday. Nothing goes on his record. I will put all of that in an email to you tonight.
The zero off tomorrow and nothing on his record, I'll take, and I'm writing both down. But a rewrite means you still think something is wrong with Owen's essay. On what basis?
Yes, all of it, in writing tonight.
That isn't what I asked, Hale. If there's nothing behind that rewrite, Owen isn't sitting it. What else do you have?
Okay, I think that is the end of the meeting. Thank you.
We're not finished. You've agreed the zero comes off tomorrow and nothing goes on his record, but you still haven't told me why Owen should sit a rewrite at all. Answer that, and then I leave.
